title: BlockChopper
tagline: Multilayered Layer 1 Layer 2 Tool to deploy multiple contracts.
description: Using the diamond standard to deploy multiple contracts to interact with Layer1 and Layer2 using Arbitrum and Skale. Other contract can be added or changed or even implement different Layer2 protocols. This will be available on a frontend as well using javascript. Current UniswapV2 and UniswapV3 have been developed, the project is still under construciton.
how_its_made: Using the Diamond standard EIP-2535 contracts that implement protocols like UniswapV2 and UniswapV3 to interact on both Layer 1 and Layer 2. Other contract can be added or changed or even implement different Layer2 proitocols. This will be available on a frontend as well using javascript.
